name: Marauder’s Momentum
body:
Prerequisite(s): Lightning Reflexes, Improved Evasion class ability.

Benefit: Whenever you successfully take no damage on a Reflex save against a spell or attack that originated from an actual target (i.e. non-trap), you may immediately take a turn so long as your turn can include an attack. This turn doesn’t upset the initiative order; instead, it grants you an extra turn. You may move and perform actions as normal (again, so long as your standard action involves an attack).

Special: You may utilize this feat only if you are wearing light or no armor.
